path.style: fill: none; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: Jensen-Shannon divergence (log2): 0 = identical, 1 = maximally different. Lower is better.
Each cell averages video-level stage JSD. n = videos containing the stage.
Unannotated frames are excluded. Task A 'drop ring' has one video; Tasks B/D have no stage labels.
